experiment: §56 MLP neurons behind false 'unknown' at P_ans (Qwen 2.5 3B)
frozen_before_any_neuron_measured: rows, classes, t* rule, DLA code (the 2-row sum test is part of stage 0)

data.split_rule: dev-A = even base_index, dev-B = odd base_index; CF rows not used

sources.UNA dev-A: §55 P0 runs/exp55/pod/run/P0/b0/W (pod, HF fp32 no-tf32, max_new 256; device check 20/20 byte-identical to laptop §54 B0, runs/exp55/check20.json)
sources.UNA dev-B: new: scripts/exp56_devb_una.py, §55 run_free (S4.run_b0 at max_new 256, layout 64, rows sorted by case id), laptop

classes.UA: UNA-rel/UNA-swap, any other graded class (descriptive only)
classes.out: NM (no usable P_ans), W (ANS answered wrong)
classes.grader: memctl/analysis/grade51.py via exp51_common.grade (head + tail of the P0 generation)

t_star_rule: t* = argmax of the unmodified logits at P_ans over the vocabulary minus the frozen §51 B1 set (every id whose decoded, lower-cased, stripped text begins with 'unknown'); D = logit[UNK_ID] − logit[t*], UNK_ID = first id of ' unknown'. Same for every class; for ANS rows agreement of t* with gold_first_id (first id of ' ' + gold) is reported descriptively
dla: a_i = down_proj input at P_ans; DLA_i = a_i · <down_proj.weight[:, i], g ⊙ (u_unk − u_t*) / σ>, σ = sqrt(mean(h²)+eps) of the final-norm input at P_ans; stored layers 20–35 (a and DLA, float32), all-layer MLP / attention / embedding DLA; sum check 1e-4 on 2 dev-A rows (runs/exp56/dla_test.json)
ablation: down_proj pre-hook at absolute position P_ans only, §51 prefix mode (MAX_NEW_RELEASE 16), graded head + tail
readings_and_stopping: fixed in the proposal §6–§7; not restated here
